name: distributed-systems-playground-ecommerce
description: E-commerce module with Saga pattern for distributed systems playground

scripts.lint: eslint --ext .js,.mjs src/ test/ scripts/ dashboard/ local-server.mjs
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --ext .js,.mjs src/ test/ scripts/ dashboard/ local-server.mjs --fix
scripts.sast:semgrep: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/src" -w /src semgrep/semgrep semgrep scan --config p/javascript --config p/nodejsscan --config p/owasp-top-ten --config p/secrets --metrics=off --timeout 60 --error --quiet .
scripts.sast:secrets: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo" zricethezav/gitleaks:latest git /repo --no-banner --redact --config /repo/.gitleaks.toml && docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo" zricethezav/gitleaks:latest dir /repo --no-banner --redact --config /repo/.gitleaks.toml
scripts.sast: npm run sast:deps && npm run sast:semgrep && npm run sast:secrets && npm run sast:iac
scripts.dast:zap: mkdir -p reports && chmod 777 reports && docker run --rm --network host -v "$PWD/reports:/zap/wrk:rw" -v "$PWD/.zap:/zap/config:ro" ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:stable zap-baseline.py -t ${DAST_TARGET:-http://localhost:3001/} -c /zap/config/rules.tsv -r zap.html -J zap.json
scripts.dast:zap:api: mkdir -p reports && chmod 777 reports && docker run --rm --network host -v "$PWD/reports:/zap/wrk:rw" -v "$PWD/.zap:/zap/config:ro" ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:stable zap-api-scan.py -t /zap/config/openapi.yaml -f openapi -O ${DAST_TARGET:-http://localhost:3001} -c /zap/config/rules-api.tsv -r zap-api.html -J zap-api.json -T 25 -I
scripts.security: npm run lint && npm run sast && npm run dast:api
